title: Primary One Social Studies — Term 3 scheme of work
summary: Ten weeks with four 40-minute periods each week: thirty teaching lessons plus the weekly reviews and final assessment inserted by Ledgerly. The school Literacy I scheme provides the sequence. SST emphasises transport users, local occupations, things made in the community, environmental features, and peaceful relationships.

units.title: Transport
units.competences: The learner identifies types and means of transport, the people who use them, safe road behaviour and the importance of transport to the community.

sources.quote: Pedestrians, passengers
People get jobs e.g taxi drivers

lessons.title: Meaning and types of transport
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to tell the meaning of transport.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to name four types of transport.

sources.quote: Transport is the movement of people and goods

lessons.title: Water transport and the people who use it
lessons.subtopic: Water transport and the people who use it
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to name two means of water transport.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to match a sailor and a captain to their work.

sources.quote: Sailors – boat, captains – ship

lessons.title: Railway transport and railway stations
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to name the means of railway transport.

sources.quote: People who fly aeroplanes are called pilots

lessons.title: Road signs and traffic lights

lessons.subtopic: Importance of transport and transport work
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to state two uses of transport.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to name two people who work in transport.
